vb_textbox.text: Hi! I found that, overall, the brown gnomes and the purple gnomes provided decent harvests between, say, 5 up to 9. However, occasionally these gnomes ceased providing decent scores so I would drop them and try other gnomes. Of these, the dark pink gnome was probably the best of the other possibilities. Other times, all patterns would seem to disappear leaving room to experiment but I didn't hit on any other reliable gnomes. Perhaps you will hit on one! Good luck.
